summary: Sealed park car park with cars already parked, no homes nearby.

best_section.where: West edge of the car park beside the grassy park, below the end of the entry road

drivers.seclusion: Open park to the west, dense trees to the east; no OSM buildings in range.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road enters at the north end; the lot is wide enough for a van beside the two parked cars.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end park access road; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Two cars parked in the lot in the imagery.

flags: Slope about 3% along the west edge
Mapped gate 198 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Open to the west and morning sun partly blocked by trees on the east; southern end shaded.
cannot_judge: Whether the park closes at night
